detail.longDescription: Many folks are as fiercely loyal to their chosen email platform as they are to their sports team. That makes the world pretty divided on Outlook and Gmail, so I decided to get to the bottom of the Outlook vs. Gmail debate. I'm a Gmail user, but I created new accounts on each platform to test them for myself. Here's what I found.
